morphology.pattern_note: 不作马来语词根或词缀拆分；正常书写首字母大写。拼写中的 ch 在所列英语读音中读 /tʃ/；无马来语派生词族可据此确认。

senses.zh_definition: 雷切尔、瑞秋等：人名 Rachel 的音译，通常用作女性名字。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name of Hebrew origin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Ibrani.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不是马来语中“母羊”的普通名称。中文译名和实际发音以本人或既有译法为准；该名字有跨语言使用情况。词源及英语读音见 [Behind the Name：Rachel](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rachel)。本项马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 原文；以下为自然的人名称呼和句法组合，未核实语料频次。

etymology.historical_story: Rachel comes from Hebrew Raḥel, meaning 'ewe'. The biblical Rachel, associated with Jacob and the mothers of Israel, helped preserve the name across religious and linguistic traditions. English later established its familiar pronunciation, while other languages retained different sounds. In Malay conversation, Rachel identifies a person; the historical meaning is not a translation of that person's name. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rachel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语读音近似“瑞秋”：想象朋友喊“瑞秋，一起吃饭！”直接把声音连到人名 Rachel。
